title: Levitation
content:
Levitation

Provides floating/levitation behavior for entities.

Component Mob

Schema

JSON
{
  "levitation": {
    "height": 2.0,
    "speed": 1.0,
    "amplitude": 0.5
  }
}

Description

The Levitation component provides floating and levitation behavior for entities. It allows entities to hover above the ground with configurable height, speed, and oscillation amplitude.

Fields

FieldTypeDescription
heightfloatThe base hover height above the ground.
speedfloatThe speed of the levitation oscillation.
amplitudefloatThe amplitude of the vertical oscillation.

Example

JSON
{
  "levitation": {
    "height": 3.0,
    "speed": 1.5,
    "amplitude": 0.8
  }
}
